Also, I need to understand the current player position. The segmentation shows:
- Node 6: color=b, pixels=24, boundary=[[8, 14], [8, 18], [12, 18], [12, 14]] - this is the player at rows 8-12, cols 14-18

# Compare before/after SPACE action (transition 39)
t=transitions[39]
before=t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')
after=t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
diffs=[]
for r in range(len(before)):
    for c in range(len(before[r])):
        if before[r][c]!=after[r][c]:
            diffs.append((r,c,before[r][c],after[r][c]))
print(f"SPACE action diffs: {len(diffs)} cells")
for d in diffs[:30]:
    print(f"  ({d[0]},{d[1]}): {d[2]}->{d[3]}")
# Also check what the player position was before SPACE
seg_before=t.before_frame.segmentation
for n in seg_before['nodes']:
    if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=30:
        print(f"Before SPACE: player node {n['id']} boundary={n['boundary']}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
